On your right there's an open door, and on your left there's a bedroom, walk towards the bedroom, turn left and walk towards the edge of the bed, turn around... You're now facing a short hallway, walk towards the hallway, in front of you there's the bathroom, walk towards the bathroom, your destination is near the sink.
